name: Blue Muffin Donut | 1.2g
description: Everyone loves donuts. A 1.2 gram glass-tip donut blunt wrapped in hemp, packed with top-shelf indoor flower, infused with live resin and rolled in kief. Finished in warm blueberry muffin straight from the oven.
